dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Five prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible on the mid-lateral flank. These structures exhibit a sharp, high-frequency gradient transition from the dark charcoal exterior fur to a high-intensity off-white perimeter. The edges are irregular and non-uniform, with the most distinct annulus located in the lower-center showing a jagged, pixelated boundary.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Clusters of high-intensity pixels are densely concentrated along the ventral-lateral margin, forming an interconnected horizontal band. These blobs lack an internal gradient and appear as solid concentrations of light-colored pixels, with the highest density observed in the posterior-midsection region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli in the central region form a scalene triangle. These keypoints are linked to a series of high-intensity blobs along the lower margin, which form a roughly linear chain that runs parallel to the ventral-most edge of the visible pelt.
